title: refactor(agent_tool): simplify mbtx, ptc, shell_exec, sandbox and auto_check
body:
- mbtx: map the run result's exit code with `result.map`, return the
  final match as the tail expression, and bind the @builtin/ name directly
- ptc: validate Content-Length / chunk-size lines with
  `is_ascii_digit` / `is_ascii_hexdigit`
- shell_exec: concatenate pending bytes with `+` and copy the UTF-8 tail
  with `to_owned()` instead of one-shot Buffers
- sandbox: drop the SourceWriteProfileScan copy of the scan builder (the
  scan now returns the mutable struct itself); `if kind is Directory && ..`
  replaces a one-arm match; `while .. is Some(offset)` replaces
  `while true { guard .. else { break } }`
- auto_check: delete the test-only `is_gateable_path` (test uses
  `gate_scratch_name` directly), inline `pad_line_number`, drop a
  redundant `else { continue }`
- tests: drop finish/plan/bgjobs/mbtx/write cases duplicated by the
  decode-package tests or broader neighbours; shell_exec spill tests use
  a per-test tmpdir removed on exit instead of fixed /tmp paths

Part of a repo-wide simplification round (obvious wins, dedupe, low-value/duplicate test removal). Behavior-preserving; `moon info` shows no `.mbti` change.
